description: List guests (contacts). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/guests. NOTE: OwnerRez REQUIRES either `q` (search) or `created_since_utc` on this endpoint. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

created_since_utc.description: Only guests created on or after this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601). Required unless q is set.

from.description: Filter to guests departing on or after this date (ISO-8601).

include_fields.description: Include the custom-fields collection on each guest.

include_tags.description: Include the tags collection on each guest.

limit.description: Max items to return per page (default set by OwnerRez, typically 10).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for paging; combine with limit).

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

q.description: Search query across guest name/email (required unless created_since_utc is set).

to.description: Filter to guests arriving on or before this date (ISO-8601).

name: list_guests
title: List guests
